name: Battered Mixer
description: An old, worn mixer console located in the community radio studio. It is operated by Noah to coax a signal during an emergency broadcast situation. The mixer is part of the studio's equipment setup, which operates under emergency power during a storm.
narrative_significance: The mixer is a critical piece of equipment for the emergency radio broadcast. Noah's ability to operate it and extract a signal from it is essential to the group's plan to communicate during a crisis when cell towers are dead and other communication methods have failed. It represents the last viable means of broadcasting emergency information.
